interpretation_ko: 일상에 자잘한 성가심이 많이 생길 조짐
interpretation_en: many little vexations will come into your daily life

cite.original: To dream of parting with friends and companions, denotes that many little vexations will come into your daily life.
cite.translation_ko: 벗과 작별하는 꿈은, 일상에 자잘한 성가심이 많이 생길 조짐이다

interpretation_en: it is a sign of success in love and business

cite.original: If you part with enemies, it is a sign of success in love and business.
cite.translation_ko: 원수와 헤어지는 꿈은, 사랑과 사업에서 성공할 조짐이다

context: 동업자가 사기그릇 바구니를 지다 떨어뜨려 뒤섞음
interpretation_ko: 동업자의 부주의한 처리로 사업에 손실을 입을 조짐
interpretation_en: denotes your business will sustain a loss through the indiscriminate dealings of your partner

cite.original: To dream of seeing your business partner with a basket of crockery on his back, and, letting it fall, gets it mixed with other crockery, denotes your business will sustain a loss through the indiscriminate dealings of your partner.
cite.translation_ko: 동업자가 사기그릇 바구니를 지다 떨어뜨려 뒤섞는 꿈은, 동업자의 부주의한 처리로 사업에 손실을 입을 조짐이다

interpretation_en: you will, to some extent, recover the loss

cite.original: If you reprimand him for it, you will, to some extent, recover the loss.
cite.translation_ko: 그 일로 동업자를 꾸짖는 꿈은, 얼마간 손실을 되찾을 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 불안정하고 오락가락하는 돈 문제를 겪을 조짐
interpretation_en: denotes uncertain and fluctuating money affairs

cite.original: To dream of forming a partnership with a man, denotes uncertain and fluctuating money affairs.
cite.translation_ko: 남자와 동업을 맺는 꿈은, 불안정하고 오락가락하는 돈 문제를 겪을 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 벗에게 숨기려 애쓸 일을 벌일 조짐
interpretation_en: you will engage in some enterprise which you will endeavor to keep hidden from friends

cite.original: If your partner be a woman, you will engage in some enterprise which you will endeavor to keep hidden from friends.
cite.translation_ko: 여자와 동업하는 꿈은, 벗에게 숨기려 애쓸 일을 벌일 조짐이다

interpretation_en: denotes that things will arrange themselves agreeable to your desires

cite.original: To dissolve an unpleasant partnership, denotes that things will arrange themselves agreeable to your desires; but if the partnership was pleasant, there will be disquieting news and disagreeable turns in your affairs.
cite.translation_ko: 불쾌했던 동업을 해소하는 꿈은, 바라던 대로 일이 풀릴 조짐이다

interpretation_en: there will be disquieting news and disagreeable turns in your affairs

cite.original: To dissolve an unpleasant partnership, denotes that things will arrange themselves agreeable to your desires; but if the partnership was pleasant, there will be disquieting news and disagreeable turns in your affairs.
cite.translation_ko: 즐거웠던 동업을 해소하는 꿈은, 심란한 소식과 일이 어긋나는 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 재산을 모으기 좋은 여건이 다가올 조짐
interpretation_en: denotes that conditions will be good in your immediate future for the accumulation of property

cite.original: Partridges seen in your dreams, denotes that conditions will be good in your immediate future for the accumulation of property.
cite.translation_ko: 자고새를 보는 꿈은, 재산을 모으기 좋은 여건이 다가올 조짐이다

interpretation_en: signifies that you will be fortunate in expectations

cite.original: To ensnare them, signifies that you will be fortunate in expectations.
cite.translation_ko: 자고새를 덫으로 잡는 꿈은, 바라던 일이 잘 풀릴 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 성공하되 재산 상당수를 남에게 내줄 조짐
interpretation_en: foretells that you will be successful, but much of your wealth will be given to others

cite.original: To kill them, foretells that you will be successful, but much of your wealth will be given to others.
cite.translation_ko: 자고새를 죽이는 꿈은, 성공하되 재산 상당수를 남에게 내줄 조짐이다

interpretation_en: signifies the enjoyment of deserved honors

cite.original: To eat them, signifies the enjoyment of deserved honors.
cite.translation_ko: 자고새를 먹는 꿈은, 합당한 영예를 누릴 조짐이다

interpretation_en: denotes that a promising future is before you

cite.original: To see them flying, denotes that a promising future is before you.
cite.translation_ko: 자고새가 나는 것을 보는 꿈은, 밝은 미래가 앞에 있다는 조짐이다
